title: Palestinian Mahmoud Abu Hamda wins top photography prize at Bayeux
description: BAYEUX, France: Palestinian freelancer Mahmoud Abu Hamda on Saturday won the photography category in the prestigious Bayeux award for war correspondents for his work from Gaza. As well as the top prize, Hamda, based in the Gaza Strip, also won the Public’s Choice award for his reportage “What the war leaves behind it.” He was not at the ceremony in Bayeux, northwest France, but sent a video message to the event. title: Libya leadership change signals major power shift
description: A few days ago, Libya’s eastern-based House of Representatives dismantled a leadership arrangement that had lasted for more than 12 years. Lawmakers approved amendments limiting the speaker and deputy speakers to a single 12-month term. The following day, legislators elected Al-Saleheen Abdul Nabi Al-Abidi, to replace Aguila Saleh, who had led the chamber since August 2014. Saleh challenged the proceedings as legally invalid.
